"'''Glacial Trespass'''" was an area designated by the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]],<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Glacial Trespass}}</ref> located in the [[Jannimak crash site|''Jannimak'' crash site]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="Wreckage on Dantooine" /> The area became infested with a rare type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that had thermal dampening properties. The plants spread frost as they grew, causing a drastic drop in [[Temperature/Legends|temperature]], making the area much colder than the rest of Dantooine's temperate climate. The effect was exacerbated by machinery built to amplify these conditions and energize the cold-dwelling creatures that survived the crash.<ref name="Codex" />

==Native Species==
Unlike in [[Sporefall]], the contact between the invasive species from [[Jannimak]] and the native [[Kath hound/Legends|Kath hounds]] was an aggressive one. Predators such as [[Vorn tiger|Vorn tigers]] hunted Kath hounds for prey.<ref name="FrostbloomSweep">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|[[Frostbloom]] Sweep|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

==GSI efforts==
The research team stationed in Glacial Trespass was led by [[Maniks|Doctor Maniks]], [[Kontor|Doctor Kontor]] and [[Sanner|Doctor Sanner]] accompanied by two researchers, [[Unidentified Twi'lek glacial researcher|one]] yellow-skinned male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and [[Unidentified Human glacial researcher|one]] light-skinned male [[Human/Legends|human]].<ref name="Glacial" /> They initiated construction of multiple ''heat lamps'' across the area, to combat the freezing. These lamps became an easy target for [[Jannimak]]'s droids, that were committed to preserving the extremely low temperatures.<ref name="Iceweeds">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Iceweeds|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

[[File:GlacialCooler-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|Machinery constructed by [[Jannimak]] droids, which [[Kontor|Dr. Kontor]] sent contractors to disable ]]
On the contrary, the machinery, droids have constructed to amplify the effects of the thermal-dampening flora, attracted the frost-loving creatures, making it very hard to approach it and turn it off. Nevertheless, [[Kontor|Doctor Kontor]] deployed slicing spikes to disable the machinery, and tasked [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors to fight through the creatures and activate them.<ref name="Frostcaller">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Frostcaller|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> Similarly, the thermal-dampening flora itself was defended by the creatures as well. Enduring the artificial cold blizzards and battling the hordes of alien animals, [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors were burning the constantly growing rootmass of the [[frostbulb]] and other similar plants that were freezing the air.<ref name="Root Cause">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Root Cause|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref><ref name="Hollow Frost">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Hollow Frost|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

Several times the forward camp at the Glacial Trespass was attacked, both by [[Jannimak]] droids<ref name="Iceweeds" /> and by [[Cryo-nester|aggressive creatures]], forcing the scientists to deploy turrets around the camp, becoming the only [[Jannimak crash site|crash site]] forward camp to do so.<ref name="Outpost Defense">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Outpost Defense|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> At the same time, some of the creatures were attempting to escape the area altogether. At the perimeter of Glacial Trespass, [[Maniks|Doctor Maniks]] organized a temporal enclosure, tasking [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors to build a fence and catch all the escaped [[cryo-nester]]s to held in there.<ref name="Unruly Nesters">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Unruly Nesters|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

===Czerka===
{{Quote|I'm sure I just saw a Czerka shuttle touch down. Those thieves aren't getting our research this time!|[[Pordav|Doctor Pordav]]|<ref name="Probe-lems" />}}
Aside from the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]], another organization that showed its interest in the phenomena occurring in the Glacial Trespass was [[Czerka Arms|Czerka]]. Czerka's spy [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] infiltrated the adjacent to the Glacial Trespass wing of the crashed [[Jannimak]] and attempted to steal the GSI's research data but GSI's contractors stopped them.<ref name="Probe-lems">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Probe-lems|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Glacial Trespass first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> The name "Glacial Trespass" isn't openly stated by an in-universe source, but exists on the game map and in the name of a codex page. On the map it is marked by [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letter [[Cresh/Legends|Cresh]].<ref>[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]</ref>
